public.text: Development partners are encouraged to support shared infrastructure, but the guidance does not define how programmes can fund shared components when donor mandates require disease-specific attribution and results.
public.suggestedRevision: Provide cost-allocation, contribution-tracking, shared-results, pooled-funding, and attribution mechanisms that allow programme funders to demonstrate value while strengthening national infrastructure.
